## Project Code Patterns
- guarded-atomic-session-mutation — Re-check stale-sensitive preconditions inside `SessionStore.mutate`, where the latest record is locked.
- latest-durable-title-projection — Persist first and route title writes through `renderSessionTitle` so projection uses the latest record and verified evidence.
- full-terminal-identity-guard — Preserve and compare adapter, window, tab, and terminal IDs for focus-derived mutations and title writes.
- bounded-shell-free-executable-adapter — Invoke local tools through injected, shell-free argv requests with explicit time/output bounds and strict response parsing.
- shared-capability-port-reuse — Define shared external capabilities once in `domain/ports.ts` and compose those narrow ports in use-case dependencies.
- port-overrideable-per-binary-composition-root — Give each installed binary one factory that wires production defaults behind narrow overrideable capabilities.
- scenario-driven-packed-cli-harness — Exercise installed bins in an isolated packed prefix using atomic scenarios and fake executable boundaries.
